// SYNTAX TEST "source.ds"

// types / generics / constraints defaults and variance
interface Store<out T: Entity = User> {
//              ^^^ keyword.operator.variance.ds
    get(id: UserId): T;
}

function decode<T>(input: Bytes): T where T: Deserialize;

// types / generics / static values associated types and constants
type InlineBytes<T, comptime N: uint = comptime 64> = [uint8; N];

type Label<T: Message> = T.Label<"created">;
//                         ^ entity.name.type.ds

type Row<...Fields: readonly (string | number)[]> = (...Fields);
//       ^^^ keyword.operator.prefix.ds

type Buffer<comptime ...Shape: readonly usize[]> = TensorBuffer<...Shape>;
//          ^^^^^^^^ keyword.other.comptime.ds
//                   ^^^ keyword.operator.prefix.ds

extension MessageOps of Message {
    type Output = string;
//  ^^^^ keyword.declaration.type.ds
    comptime const MaxSize: uint = 64;
//  ^^^^^^^^ keyword.other.comptime.ds
}
